name: CinemaStudio
subtitle: Mobile cinematic studio
promotionalText: Edit films on your phone. Local-first. Pro workflow.
description:
CinemaStudio is a premium mobile cinematic editing studio — not a social editor. Create projects locally, import media, edit on a timeline, and export H.264 — all on device.

• Local-first — your projects stay on your device
• Cinematic UI — minimal, guided workflow
• AI orchestrator — suggestions, not chat
• Optional cloud backup and Pro subscription
